name: Head Nod/Shake Pattern
description: Analyzes head nodding and shaking patterns for natural conversational synchronization — AI often desynchronizes.
mechanism:
This method analyzes head gesture dynamics for deepfake detection:

1. **HeadPose跟踪**: Head orientation (yaw, pitch, roll) is estimated per frame using facial landmark geometry or 3D head model fitting. Head pose signals are decomposed to identify gestural movements (nods = pitch oscillation, shakes = yaw oscillation).

2. **GestureKinematics分析**: Natural head gestures follow specific kinematics: (a) nodding involves 10-20° pitch oscillation at 1-2 Hz, (b) shaking involves 15-30° yaw oscillation at 1-2.5 Hz, (c) gestures show smooth sinusoidal profiles with physiologically constrained velocity. The method checks whether detected gestures fall within natural kinematic parameters.

3. **Gesture-语音相关性**: Head gestures correlate with speech prosody — nods often coincide with stressed syllables, head movements accompany turn-taking in conversation. The method analyzes temporal correlation between head motion and speech intensity. Deepfakes may show gestures temporally decoupled from speech.

4. **Neck-HeadCoordination**: Head rotation involves coupled neck and cervical spine motion with characteristic ranges — large yaw rotations involve torso contribution. The method verifies head-neck-shoulder coordination. Deepfake generators that only manipulate the face may produce head rotations that don't propagate correctly to neck and shoulders.

5. **Inertial一致性**: Head motion should show proper inertial dynamics — acceleration/deceleration following the mass and muscle force constraints of the head-neck system. The method analyzes the frequency content and jerk profile of head motion. AI-generated head movements may lack natural inertial characteristics.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用
